name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, lower the bar under control to the chest, then press upward.

name: Squat
instructions: Brace your core, descend until your thighs are at least parallel, then drive upward.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips, keep the bar close, and stand tall without overextending.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Pull your chest toward the bar while keeping your core engaged.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Press the bar overhead while keeping ribs down and core tight.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support your torso and row the dumbbell toward your hip.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Push hips back with a soft knee bend and feel a hamstring stretch.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Maintain a straight line from head to heels and lower under control.
